question: Does the exact SGLang v0.5.15 native depth-12 NGRAM verification path contain a semantics-preserving per-step launch, host synchronization, or graph-boundary cost that can be removed or captured on H100?
why_now: The direct H100 endpoint is in flight on a warm exact-runtime bench. Persistent local-KV residency and page-transaction coalescing are already closed, while the completed overflow analysis makes endpoint service time decisive at 0.693940 and 0.624546 seconds/request. A source-complete launch/synchronization candidate can be prepared offline without disturbing the endpoint and, if credible, becomes a compatible warm-bench follow-up.

research_contract.skill: Use $kernel-research for exact source, graph, stream, launch, and accelerator-boundary reasoning.
research_contract.event_chain: Reconstruct the exact depth-12 NGRAM proposal, model/verification, hybrid-attention, CUDA-graph, result-transfer, acceptance, and scheduler update sequence. Name every relevant producer, consumer, stream/event, graph capture boundary, and host-visible synchronization in the bound sources.
research_contract.launch_model: Build a deterministic per-decode-step event and launch-count model for the settled H100 geometry. Separate compulsory model and attention launches from avoidable host synchronization, scalar/index materialization, graph breaks, and postprocess launches. Label time bounds analytical or synthetic; do not manufacture measured microseconds.
research_contract.candidate: Nominate at most one semantics-preserving source-complete change, such as capture-safe device-side acceptance/result processing or removal of a proven redundant synchronization. Specify exact symbols, state ownership, mutation order, padding/dynamic-batch behavior, and why accepted-token semantics remain unchanged.
research_contract.cpu_oracle: Provide a CPU event/state oracle covering zero acceptance, partial acceptance, full depth-12 acceptance, mixed batch rows, padded graph rows, request completion, and request-slot reuse.
research_contract.whole_request_bound: Translate only source-proven avoided events into a conservative endpoint service-time interval and state whether it could cross either 0.693940 or 0.624546 seconds/request. Do not credit speculative overlap or compulsory compute.
research_contract.falsifier: Specify the smallest future checkpoint-free H100 Nsight Systems or exact-consumer test that can falsify the predicted launch/synchronization change before any endpoint run.
research_contract.typed_none: Return typed_none if the exact path contains no removable boundary with a credible whole-request consequence, if the boundary is already graph-captured, or if semantics require the synchronization.

required_outputs: hash verification of every bound input
compulsory versus avoidable launch and synchronization accounting
one candidate plus CPU oracle and smallest H100 falsifier, or typed_none
measured, analytical, inferred, and synthetic evidence labels

budgets.local_compute: At most 25 CPU-minutes and 2 GiB RAM; no CUDA.

prohibitions: Do not create, claim, inspect, SSH to, or mutate a provider resource or GPU bench.
Do not read, poll, signal, or modify the in-flight endpoint owner or its artifact directory.
Do not modify any file in gemma4_h100_v0515_ngram_price_normalized.
Do not replay the consumed discriminator or invoke the 791-request endpoint.
Do not reopen persistent L2 residency or request-owned KV transaction coalescing.
Do not present static launch counts or synthetic timing as measured H100 improvement.
Do not implement a production patch or broaden into a flag sweep.
